name: Easy "Pizza" Butter Bean Casserole with Pepperoni, Veggies & Garlic Bread

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl along with mushrooms.
Drain and rinse beans. Drain olives. Add both to the bowl with the veggies, along with pizza sauce, pepperoni, cheese, and spices. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (15 oz) can butter beans
1 (2.25 oz) can sliced black olives
1 (14 oz) jar pizza sauce
1 (6 oz) pkg pepperoni
1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
1 tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer pizza mixture to a large baking or casserole dish and spread out in an even layer; sprinkle with additional cheese. Place casserole in the preheated oven and bake until warmed through and golden on top, 35-40 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, remove garlic toast from the freezer and set aside to thaw slightly.
When the casserole is done, change oven to 425°F. Separate toast slices, arrange on a baking sheet pan, and place in the oven; bake until golden and toasted, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Divide pizza casserole between plates or bowls. Serve with garlic toast on the side and enjoy!
